name: Loaded Baked Potatoes
summary: Baked potatoes stuffed with cheddar, black beans, and green onion.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Prick the potatoes all over with a fork.
Bake directly on the rack for 55–65 minutes, until a knife slides in easily.
Warm the black beans in a small pot with a pinch of salt.
Split each potato open, fluff the inside with a fork, and add a knob of butter.
Top with the black beans, cheddar, and green onions. Season and serve.
budgetNotes: Microwave the potatoes for 10 minutes first if you are short on time, then crisp in the oven.
Any leftover chili, beans, or vegetables make a good topping.
A spoon of plain yogurt stands in for sour cream.
